conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: You are not reflecting. You are lying.
Police: When Xiyuan went missing, who was around, what were they wearing, which direction did you flee from—
Police: You can’t answer any of these questions.
Police: Mr. Jin Kangshi:
Police: You say you are the one who kidnapped the child.
Police: Is it possible that you are actually depriving Ms. Minyoung of the chance to atone and be forgiven?
Police: You can bear the punishment for her now, but what about after she recovers?
Police: At that time, she will have to face her own self-blame and guilt!
Police: Can you bear that for her?
Police: Your mother-in-law is in the room next door. She has already told me everything.
Police: In order to protect her son-in-law, she had no choice but to report her own biological daughter. Think about how she must feel right now.
Police: I know that you have been covering Ms. Song Minyoung’s rehabilitation treatment expenses under the name of child support.
Police: Now I ask you to take one more step back and stand behind her to support her.
Police: If Ms. Minyoung is sent for treatment and supervision, it will be a very long battle.
Respondent: ...Officer Quan.
Respondent: Do you think it’s possible that I made a mistake with the very first step?
Respondent: ...The name Xiyuan...
Respondent: Could it be that everything turned out this way because I gave her the wrong name...?
